description: Menstrual cycle tracking as of one date, in two parts returned as Garmin sends them: summary (Garmin's cycle summary for that date) and dayView (Garmin's day view for that date, with anything logged). Empty unless the user tracks their cycle in Garmin Connect. date accepts YYYY-MM-DD, 'today' or 'yesterday'; call once per date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or 'today' / 'yesterday' (resolved in the user's Garmin time zone).

name: get_menstrual_cycle
title: Menstrual cycle (one day)
